mapper.sql: C.ID, C.SUPPLY_ID, C.AUTHOR, C.CONTENT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(C.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = C.AUTHOR) AUTHOR_NAME
